title: Holtec Pioneer 2 (SMR-300 at Palisades): Email to Holtec - Pre-Acceptance Regulatory Audit Plan for the Palisades SMR, LLC Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Construction Permit [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:           Michael Orenak
To:             8569570955 Jake Dolecki
Cc:             Michelle Hayes; Mihaela Biro; Tony Nakanishi
Subject:        Pre-Acceptance Regulatory Audit Plan for the Palisades SMR, LLC Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Construction Permit
Date:           Friday, November 6, 2026 8:29:00 AM
Attachments:    Pre-Acceptance Regulatory Audit Plan for the Palisades SMR, LLC Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Construction Permit.pdf


Dear Mr. Dolecki,

By letter dated September 30, 2026, (ADAMS Accession No. ML26273A416), SMR, LLC,
on behalf of Palisades SMR, LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Holtec International
(collectively, Holtec) submitted to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), an
application for a construction permit for Pioneer Units 1 and 2, pursuant to Title 10 of the
Code of Federal Regulations (10 CFR) Part 50, “Domestic Licensing of Production and
Utilization Facilities.” The application is still under acceptance review per 10 CFR 2.101(a)
(2).

The NRC staff has determined that a regulatory audit would assist in the acceptance review
of the application, primarily focusing on the preliminary safety analysis report and proposed
exemptions. The NRC staff will conduct the audit to seek clarification, gain understanding,
and verify information to determine the completeness and technical sufficiency of the
application. The NRC staff will coordinate with Holtec to start the audit in November 2026,
in accordance with the audit plan attached to this email.

If you have any questions, please contact Michael Orenak at 301-415-3229 or via email at
michael.orenak@nrc.gov.

Sincerely,


Michael D. Orenak, Senior Project Manager
Advanced Reactor Licensing Branch 2 (ARLB2)
OAR – Division of Advanced Reactor Licensing (DARL)
301-415-3229
Michael.Orenak@nrc.gov
